# Graph Database

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../), one of its top concepts._

Graph databases that support a PKM system.

## Scope note

- Includes Neo4j Desktop, Neo4j Community, Neo4j Aura (cloud), LadybugDB using Cypher graph query language.
- Includes TypeDB using TypeQL.
